cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: HYPE value totalHypeValueReturned recorded in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount when a user cancels a withdrawal request

caller_has_manager_role.meaning: the caller of redelegateWithdrawnHYPE holds MANAGER_ROLE privileges

redelegation_lost_amount.meaning: HYPE amount lost from the re-delegation process on a redelegateWithdrawnHYPE call, reported as _cancelledWithdrawalAmount % 1e10

assumptions: A user has cancelled a withdrawal request so _cancelledWithdrawalAmount holds the recorded HYPE value before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE is called.
The re-delegation path uses OperationType.SpotDeposit via _distributeStake.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the remainder loss occurs on every call or only when _cancelledWithdrawalAmount is not a multiple of 1e10; the impact is conditional on the amount not being an exact multiple of 1e10.

limitations: The loss magnitude is bounded by the report as less than 1e-8 HYPE (remainder below 1e10 wei); the exact per-call value depends on the concrete cancelled amount.
Only the per_call_loss impact is formalized here; stranded_value, permanent_lock and khype_profit_reduction are handled in separate passes.
